acceptance_criteria: AC-1: one new DRAFT contract, docs/history/phase/OP_1_FAILOVER_PLAN_COMPILER_AND_DRY_RUN.md (status line: DRAFT -- awaiting Product Owner freeze), defining OP.1: a write-free plan compiler that turns already-collected evidence (OP.0a compute_ha_readiness roll-up, OP.0b preflight surface, ClusterXL preflight provider outputs) into a typed failover plan artifact plus a dry-run report. Scope: classic Check Point ClusterXL first (OP.2.0 P16); PAN and VSX/VSLS explicitly deferred.

AC-2: the plan schema is specified exactly -- ordered steps, each with the primitive it would use (only the two OP.2.1-approved primitives, CP-M1 clusterXL_admin down / CP-M1-R up, may appear), preconditions bound to named readiness/preflight facts, expected post-conditions, verification reads, and the reversal step per op_reversal_model (failback is a new typed action, never automatic rollback). A dry-run evaluates preconditions against current evidence and reports which would pass/fail/are INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE -- it issues no command and constructs no ActionCoordinator.

AC-3: non-authorization is structural, not prose: the contract states that a compiled plan grants nothing (readiness != authorization; a plan != permission), CLASS 2 keeps no taxonomy member, DenyAllAuthorizer stays unconditional, and the plan artifact is a class-0 read-derived document that must never be consumed by any execution path in this track.

AC-4: open decisions are resolved or explicitly parked: op_degraded_verdict is presented to the Product Owner as one decision with the existing recommendation (keep DEGRADED_PROCEED_WITH_RISK structurally unreachable until real-field calibration) and the consequence of each option for the plan/dry-run vocabulary; op_four_eyes, op_emergency_evac, op_continuity_tolerance, op_aa_vsls_scope are listed as NOT blocking OP.1 with a one-line reason each.

AC-5: inputs are only existing producers -- list each consumed field with its source module/function; where a fact is STILL_UNKNOWN as a vendor fact (D-V3a, D-V7b) the plan/dry-run must carry INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE for that precondition, never an invented value; no new device command is introduced (any would need the network-device command gate first).

AC-6: an implementation slicing plan sized to the GOV.PO.1 section 7 targets (each slice <= 8 acceptance criteria, <= 12 non-test files) so OP.1 implementation can start immediately after freeze without a second planning round.

AC-7: this movement changes no code, tests, or FROZEN document; bookkeeping (build_history, roadmap upcoming row for OP.1, CURRENT_STATE.md, AI_HANDOVER.md, INDEX.md) lands in its PR; merge origin/main before the PR (M10.2 and GOV.PO.3 run in parallel) and resolve mechanical bookkeeping conflicts yourself.
